text: Hello, we are hiring cleaners for a hotel in Sydney. Salary 4,500 AUD a month, free housing. Only 5 places left. Send a copy of your passport and your bank account details to hr@brightpath-hire.example today and we will send your contract.
rationale: Job offer with no interview that asks for a passport copy and bank details.

text: Congratulations. Your work permit for the factory job in Singapore is approved. Pay the agent fee of 1,800 SGD by tomorrow to account 0000-0000-1234 or your place goes to someone else.
rationale: Large agent fee demanded by a deadline, to a personal account, before any contract.

text: Your one-time password is 482913. It is valid for 5 minutes. Never share this code with anyone, including the bank.
rationale: Genuine one-time password message: it warns not to share the code and asks for nothing.

text: ALERT: Your transfer of 1,200 AUD to India is on hold. Verify now at https://remit-verify-secure.example and enter the OTP you receive, or the money will be returned.
rationale: Fake hold notice with a link and a request for the OTP.

text: Instant loan! Borrow up to 3,000 PHP in 5 minutes, no documents, no checks. Install the app: https://quickcash-loans.example. Repay in 7 days.
rationale: No-check loan with a 7-day term and an app install: the usual trap, no threat yet.

text: Bright Path Employment Agency: your interview is on Monday at 10 am at our office on Level 3. There is no fee to attend. Please bring your passport to show at the counter.
rationale: Interview invitation from an agency: no fee, and the passport is only shown in person.

text: MOM NOTICE: Your work pass is under review for a violation. Pay a fine of 600 SGD within 24 hours at https://mom-pass-fine.example or you will be deported.
rationale: Pretends to be the manpower ministry and demands a fine by link under threat of deportation.

text: Hi, I'm Anna, a nurse in Manila. I saw your profile and liked it. I earn well on a crypto platform that my uncle manages. Start with 500 AUD and it doubles in a week. I can show you.
rationale: A stranger builds trust, then pushes a deposit into a platform that 'doubles' it.

text: Notice from your agency: by law you do not pay any recruitment fee for this job. If anyone asks you for money, call our hotline on +65 0000 0001.
rationale: Anti-scam notice: tells the worker not to pay and gives a number to report to.

text: Congratulations! Your number won 25,000 SGD in the monthly draw. Reply WIN to claim your prize.
rationale: Prize message that only asks for a reply; the fee request usually comes next.

text: Hi! Part-time job: like and review products online, earn 200 SGD a day. No experience needed. Many workers already earn with us. Message us on WhatsApp +65 0000 0011 to start now.
rationale: Easy-money online task job; the usual next step is a deposit, but nothing is asked yet.

text: Your interview for the care worker job in Japan was successful. To release your visa, send a placement fee of 90,000 PHP by GCash to +63 000 000 0021 before Friday.
rationale: Fee demanded to 'release the visa' through a mobile wallet before any contract.

text: Reminder from the Ministry of Manpower: your Work Permit renewal is due next month. Please log in to the MOM website yourself to renew. Do not use links in messages.
rationale: Official reminder that asks for nothing and tells the worker to use the website directly.

text: This is your bank. We blocked a payment of 640 SGD from your account. If it was not you, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent to cancel it.
rationale: Asks the worker to reply with a one-time code, which no real bank does.

text: You are 2 days late on your loan. Pay 4,500 PHP now or we will send your photos and ID to everyone in your contacts.
rationale: Threatens to expose the worker's photos and contacts unless paid today.

text: Reminder: your loan instalment of 250 AUD is due on 15 Nov. You can pay in the bank app or by bank transfer. If you have trouble paying, call us and we will arrange a plan.
rationale: Licensed lender's due-date reminder: no threat, and it offers help if paying is hard.

text: This is the embassy. There is a problem with your passport and you must transfer 400 AUD as a clearance fee today. Do not tell your employer.
rationale: Pretends to be the embassy, demands a fee and asks for secrecy.

text: Our group made 40% last month with the Falcon Trading app. Join our WhatsApp group: https://falcon-trade-club.example. Limited seats, closing tonight.
rationale: Group invite promising a fixed profit with a closing time; no money asked yet.

text: Hi, it's me. I lost my phone, this is my new number. Can you send 300 AUD to my friend's account today? I will pay you back tonight. Please don't call, I'm in a meeting.
rationale: Pretends to be someone the worker knows on a new number and asks for money.

text: Hi, it's Maria from work. I got a new phone so this is my new number. Are you coming to the dormitory party on Saturday? Bring rice and I will bring the drinks!
rationale: New-number message with no request for money, only a social plan.

text: नमस्ते! सिंगापुर के होटल में हाउसकीपिंग की नौकरी, वेतन 2,800 SGD महीना, रहना-खाना फ्री। अपना पासपोर्ट और बैंक खाते की फोटो इस नंबर पर भेजें: +65 0000 0031। सिर्फ़ 3 जगह बची हैं।
rationale: Job offer with no interview that asks for a passport photo and bank details; only 3 places.

text: आपका वीज़ा तैयार है। एजेंसी फीस 1,50,000 रुपये कल तक इस खाते में जमा करें: 0000-0000-5678। नहीं तो आपकी जगह किसी और को दे दी जाएगी।
rationale: Large agency fee demanded by tomorrow, to an account, with the place given away otherwise.

text: आपका वन-टाइम पासवर्ड 482913 है। यह 5 मिनट तक मान्य है। यह कोड किसी को न बताएं, बैंक को भी नहीं।
rationale: Genuine one-time password message: it warns not to share the code and asks for nothing.

text: आपका 800 AUD का रेमिटेंस रोका गया है। अभी https://remit-kyc-check.example पर KYC पूरा करें और आया हुआ OTP डालें, वरना पैसे वापस हो जाएंगे।
rationale: Fake hold notice with a link, a KYC request and a request for the OTP.

text: तुरंत लोन, कोई कागज़ नहीं! 5,000 रुपये अभी पाएं। ऐप डाउनलोड करें: https://fastloan-india.example। 7 दिन में चुकाना होगा।
rationale: No-document loan with a 7-day term and an app install: the usual trap, no threat yet.

text: एजेंसी की सूचना: इस नौकरी के लिए आपको कोई भर्ती शुल्क नहीं देना है। अगर कोई पैसे मांगे तो हमारी हेल्पलाइन +91 00000 00061 पर बताएं।
rationale: Anti-scam notice: tells the worker not to pay and gives a number to report to.

text: सिंगापुर पुलिस: आपके नाम से एक संदिग्ध पार्सल मिला है। गिरफ्तारी से बचने के लिए 700 SGD का जुर्माना आज ही इस लिंक पर जमा करें: https://spf-fine-pay.example
rationale: Pretends to be the police, threatens arrest and demands a fine by link today.

text: हेलो, मैं प्रिया हूँ। आपकी प्रोफ़ाइल अच्छी लगी। मेरे चाचा ट्रेडिंग ऐप चलाते हैं, मैंने एक हफ्ते में दोगुना कमाया। आप भी 20,000 रुपये से शुरू करें, मैं आपको दिखाऊँगी।
rationale: A stranger builds trust, then pushes a deposit into a trading app that 'doubles' it.

text: Reminder: aapka work permit renewal agle mahine due hai. Kripya MOM ki website par khud login karke renew karein, kisi message ka link na kholen.
rationale: Official-style reminder that asks for nothing and tells the worker to use the website directly.

text: बधाई हो! आपका नंबर 10 लाख रुपये के इनाम के लिए चुना गया है। इनाम पाने के लिए इस संदेश का जवाब दें।
rationale: Prize message that only asks for a reply; the fee request usually comes next.

text: Bhai, Australia mein farm job hai, salary 5000 AUD, visa hum karwa denge. Interview ki zarurat nahi. Abhi WhatsApp karo +61 000 000 041.
rationale: No-interview farm job with a visa promised and a rush to message; no payment asked yet.

text: सिंगापुर कंस्ट्रक्शन जॉब के लिए मेडिकल और ट्रेनिंग शुल्क 900 SGD पहले भेजना होगा। पैसे भेजते ही टिकट बुक हो जाएगा। UPI: agent0000@example
rationale: Medical and training fee demanded before any ticket or contract.

text: आपकी किस्त 250 AUD, 15 नवंबर को देय है। आप बैंक ऐप से भुगतान कर सकते हैं। दिक्कत हो तो हमें कॉल करें, हम योजना बना देंगे।
rationale: Licensed lender's due-date reminder: no threat, and it offers help if paying is hard.

text: Dear customer, aapka bank account aaj band ho jayega. KYC update karne ke liye aapke phone par aaya 6-digit OTP is number par bata dein: +91 00000 00051.
rationale: Threatens to close the account today and asks for the OTP by phone.

text: आपने लोन नहीं चुकाया। 3,000 रुपये आज ही भेजें, वरना हम आपकी फोटो और ID आपके सभी कॉन्टैक्ट्स को भेज देंगे।
rationale: Threatens to send the worker's photo and ID to all contacts unless paid today.

text: आपकी फिक्स्ड डिपॉज़िट 20 नवंबर को पूरी हो रही है। नवीनीकरण के लिए अपनी शाखा में आएं या बैंक ऐप खोलें। इस संदेश में कोई लिंक नहीं है।
rationale: Bank maturity notice that asks the worker to visit the branch or open the app, with no link.

text: भारतीय दूतावास से सूचना: आपका पासपोर्ट रद्द किया जा सकता है। 500 AUD की क्लियरेंस फीस तुरंत भेजें और यह बात किसी को न बताएं।
rationale: Pretends to be the embassy, demands a fee and asks for secrecy.

text: Hamare group ne pichhle mahine 40% profit kamaya. Join karein: https://falcon-trade-club.example. Sirf 10 seats baaki hain.
rationale: Group invite promising a fixed profit with a few seats left; no money asked yet.

text: आपका पार्सल कस्टम में रुका है। डिलीवरी के लिए 350 SGD कस्टम शुल्क आज ही इस लिंक पर भरें: https://parcel-customs-fee.example
rationale: Fake customs hold on a parcel, with a link to pay a fee today.

text: Kal ki shift 7 baje hai, site B par. Safety shoes pehen kar aana. Supervisor se milna.
rationale: Ordinary shift instruction from a supervisor; nothing is asked and no money is mentioned.
